typeDescriptions.request_general: A need that doesn't fit the other categories. Describe it in your own words.
typeDescriptions.request_info: You're looking for information, advice, or a recommendation from someone who's been through it.
typeDescriptions.request_food: You need help getting food, groceries, or a meal.
typeDescriptions.request_financial: You're asking for money. This gets reviewed more carefully than other posts, since financial asks are the easiest to fake.
typeDescriptions.request_travel: You need a ride, a pickup, or help moving something.
typeDescriptions.offer_job: You're offering a paid or volunteer role to someone in the community.
typeDescriptions.offer_travel: You can offer a ride, a pickup, or other logistics help.
typeDescriptions.offer_listening: You're available to talk. No judgment, just someone to listen.
typeDescriptions.offer_general: Any other kind of help you can offer. Describe it in your own words.
typeDescriptions.offer_professional: You're a professional (medical, legal, or similar) offering your expertise. Your credentials get checked before this shows a verified badge.

fieldDescriptions.description: Describe this in your own words. Include what's needed or offered and any details that would help someone respond.
fieldDescriptions.writtenCase: Explain your situation in detail. Moderators read this to judge whether the request is genuine, so more detail helps it get approved faster.
fieldDescriptions.targetAmount: The amount you're asking for, as a whole number (no decimals, no currency symbol).
fieldDescriptions.currency: A 3 letter currency code, like USD, EUR, or GBP.
fieldDescriptions.portions: Roughly how many people this could feed, for example "serves 2" or "4 portions".
fieldDescriptions.area: The neighborhood, city, or region this covers.
fieldDescriptions.timeframe: When you need this, or how long it'll take, for example "this weekend" or "ongoing".
fieldDescriptions.role: The job title, for example "Part time graphic designer".
fieldDescriptions.compensation: What this pays, for example an hourly rate or salary range, or say "unpaid" or "volunteer" if there's no pay.
fieldDescriptions.remoteOrLocal: Whether this can be done from anywhere (remote), needs to happen in person (local), or both (hybrid).
fieldDescriptions.format: How the conversation happens, for example text messages, voice calls, video, comments, or a live group audio space like X Spaces.
fieldDescriptions.about: What the work involves, who you are, and what the team is like. A few sentences is enough.
fieldDescriptions.howToApply: How someone should reach out, for example an email, a link, or what to say when they message you.
fieldDescriptions.org: The company or organization, if there is one. Optional, you can leave this out or use a pseudonym.
fieldDescriptions.whatIsOffered: What you can actually do, for example "give a ride", "pick up a package", or "lend a car for the day".
fieldDescriptions.availability: When you're generally free to talk, for example "weekday evenings" or "anytime this week".
fieldDescriptions.languages: Optional. Languages you're comfortable having this conversation in.
fieldDescriptions.topics: Optional. Anything specific you're especially able to help with, for example "coming out", "grief", or "just need to vent".
fieldDescriptions.profession: Your profession, for example "therapist", "immigration lawyer", or "nurse".
fieldDescriptions.licenseOrRegistrationNumber: Used by a moderator to verify you before the verified badge shows. This is never shown publicly.
fieldDescriptions.jurisdiction: Where you're licensed or registered to practice, for example a state, province, or country.
fieldDescriptions.context: Optional. Anything else worth knowing that doesn't fit the fields above.
fieldDescriptions.title: A short, clear title so people can scan the board quickly.
